The vehicles that you can buy have a bump in xp. There is gold you can buy to convert rep gained form vehicles that are 100% maxed out. But it isnt necessary. You can also buy premium time that gives you a bump in xp and in came money. I use to play war thunder but i have argued  on here the pvp in it people use aim bots to cheat. At least this game no one can really cheap. Over all I have had a nice experience with the game. Matches go pretty fast even the story line matches go pretty fast 5 to 10 mins. Its fun there are alot of tanks and you can really play any style you want. If you are bored with WoT and warthunder  Give this game a try
